keywords: Anthropic 用 Mythos 审计 Zcash
summary: 周六较安静。zooko 表示，应 Shielded Labs 请求，Anthropic 用 Mythos 对 Zcash 做了安全审计，没有发现更多严重的协议漏洞，加固工作仍在继续。ethrex 开始运行新的 benchmarkoor BAL 测试集后，在两个基准中都进入前三，计算测试集吞吐约 1.95 Ggas/s。

items.title: zooko：感谢 Anthropic 帮助保护 Zcash 用户
items.note: 04:09。应 Shielded Labs 请求，Anthropic 用 Mythos 对 Zcash 做了安全审计，没有发现 Zcash 协议中更多严重漏洞，Shielded Labs 等方面的安全加固工作仍在继续。
items.title_en: zooko: thanks to Anthropic for helping protect Zcash users
items.note_en: 04:09. At Shielded Labs' request, Anthropic ran a security audit of Zcash with Mythos and found no more serious bugs in the Zcash protocol; Shielded Labs and others continue security hardening work.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. zooko said that at Shielded Labs' request, Anthropic ran a security audit of Zcash with Mythos and found no more serious bugs in the protocol, while hardening work continues. A few days after starting the new benchmarkoor BAL suites, ethrex is among the top three clients in both benchmarks, at about 1.95 Ggas/s on the compute suite.
